title: COMPASS site configuration
description: Schema for every COMPASS site.toml. The workspace .taplo.toml provides one central Even Better TOML association, avoiding stale per-document schema directives. Gives autocomplete, hover documentation, and validation including typo detection via additionalProperties:false.

simulation.description: Select spatial assembly and the point-scale driver before optional inputs are read.

spatial_mode.description: point = one vertical column; regional = multiple point columns assembled for regional execution.

point_context.description: field = natural atmosphere-canopy-soil driver; laboratory = standalone prescribed-boundary soil-water driver. Regional currently requires field.

dt_min.description: [s] Min adaptive substep (shrink target on failure).

forcing_timescale.description: Forcing input cadence; daily is interpolated to hourly via diurnal method. [lTimeScale]

clock_basis.description: Time base of the forcing timestamps. 'local_standard' = station clock (e.g. Beijing UTC+8); 'utc' = global reanalysis (ERA5). Internal model time is always UTC; solar geometry uses UTC + lon/lat.

utc_offset.description: [h] Clock offset from UTC for clock_basis='local_standard' (clock = UTC + utc_offset; Beijing = 8). Ignored when clock_basis='utc'.

forcing_start.description: First timestamp in the forcing file (clock time). Defaults to 'start' if omitted; decouples the forcing origin from the simulation start.

grid.description: Soil column depth and vertical discretization.

uniform_grid.description: false = non-uniform (dense near surface), true = uniform. [lEqlspace]

NS.description: Number of soil.csv rows (horizons or sampled depths, depending on soil_input.vertical_parameter_mode).

soil_input.description: Interpretation of soil.csv depth_cm when mapping static soil parameters to computational elements.

vertical_parameter_mode.description: sample_linear (default): depth_cm is a sample location; linearly interpolate primitive parameters to element centers and hold endpoint values. horizon_bounds: depth_cm is each piecewise-constant horizon's lower boundary (legacy COMPASS tiling).

switches.description: Physical-process on/off flags (loader maps true/false to 1/0).

solve_soil_air.description: Solve soil dry-air pressure (off = ignore gas phase). [lSoilairefc]

solve_nitrogen.description: Solve soil nitrogen cycle (off = no soil N). [lNefc]

plant_cn_cycle.description: Plant (above-ground) carbon-nitrogen cycle: allocation, NSC, and plant respiration (runPlantCNStep). Maps to lPlantCN.

soil_carbon_model.description: Master for native AOM-DOM-MEMC/MEND soil organic C/N. false restores COMPASS empirical mineralization and forces dependent soil-C switches off.

dissolved_organic_matter.description: DOC/DON total-store transport and equilibrium sorption. Requires soil_carbon_model=true.

explicit_soil_microbes.description: MEMC explicit microbial carbon pools and reactions. Requires dissolved_organic_matter=true.

litter_input.description: Live PlantCN litter input and CoLM vertical mixing. Requires PlantCN and disables synthetic residue input.

microbial_dormancy.description: MEND active-dormant exchange and dormant maintenance; requires explicit microbes.

microbial_transport.description: BIOPARTICLE transport-only mobile/attached/retained microbial phases; requires explicit microbes.

root_water_uptake.description: Master switch for all root-water uptake. false stages and commits zero RWU/Srt, independent of PlantCN. Maps to lRwuef.

root_nitrogen_uptake.description: Master switch for all root NH4/NO3 uptake. PlantCN on uses demand-capped DAISY+Nacry; PlantCN off uses passive max(Srt,0)*C. Maps to lRsuef.

dallamico_phase_change.description: Finite-rate phase relaxation. false keeps strict SFCC instantaneous equilibrium as the sole phase-change closure. [lDallAmicoPhaseChange]

thermal_conductivity_model.description: Thermal conductivity model: de_vries=1 (default), tian=3, peters_lidard/johansen=2, farouki=4. [lThermCond]

effective_thermal_properties.description: Compute effective thermal conductivity + heat capacity (standard). [lThmrlCondCap]

ebal_anderson_latent.description: ebal latent-heat closure uses the Anderson formulation (legacy default true when unset). [lEbalAnderson]

nitrogen_input_phase.description: Phase of soil_initial_profile.csv NH4/NO3. 'total' = mg/kg dry soil (e.g. KCl-extractable total mineral N), converted to liquid concentration via theta and NH4 adsorption (theta+RHOKG). 'dissolved' = mg/L soil solution, used directly as the liquid concentration.

bulk_density_source.description: Which bulk density sets porosity and thermal parameters. 'initial' = soil_initial_profile.csv per-depth bulk density overrides; 'soil' = keep soil.csv per-horizon bulk density.

diurnal_temp_method.description: Daily->hourly air-temperature disaggregation. 'legacy_sine' = fixed cosine with peak at 15:00 (MeteoData behaviour). 'sunrise_anchored' = sunrise/sunset-anchored sine in daytime (Tmin at sunrise+1.5h, Tmax near solar noon+1.5h) with linear night cooling and cross-day continuity.

tol_surface_water_cm.description: [cm/step] Maximum absolute surface-reservoir mass residual and complementarity depth ruler.

tol_energy_balance_J_cm2.description: [J/cm2/step] Maximum absolute exact soil-column internal-energy residual.

tol_air_mass_g_cm2.description: [g/cm2/step] Maximum absolute exact soil-column dry-air mass residual.

soil_interface_closure_enable.description: Enable outer scalar interface-temperature closure while retaining a strict Dirichlet soil top.

soil_interface_closure_tol_W_m2.description: [W/m2] Absolute soil-reaction minus frozen-surface heat-flux tolerance.

soil_interface_closure_max_iters.description: Maximum guarded secant updates after the initial guess and directed probe.

soil_interface_closure_substep_retry_ena.description: Retry an atmospheric heat-flux closure on finer accepted soil time tiles before fallback.

soil_interface_closure_substep_retry_fac.description: Geometric reduction factor for heat-closure soil time-tile retries.

soil_interface_closure_substep_retry_max.description: Maximum number of finer time-tile levels used by atmospheric heat closure.

soil_interface_closure_bounded_acceptanc.description: Allow a fully converged finite soil trial with a non-strict but explicitly bounded interface residual.

soil_interface_closure_bounded_tol_W_m2.description: Absolute hard cap for bounded atmospheric interface residual acceptance.

soil_interface_closure_bounded_relative_.description: Additional interface-flux-relative cap for bounded residual acceptance.

hydraulic_kernel.description: Hydraulic-property kernel: array (vectorized) or scalar (reference, for A/B verification).

matric_kernel.description: Richards matric-coefficient kernel: array (vectorized) or scalar (reference).

extrapolate.description: lExtrap — temporal extrapolation for initial guess.

upwind.description: lUpW — upwind scheme for convective terms.

substep_enabled.description: Enable adaptive Richards substep growth and retry shrinkage.

substep_grow_factor.description: [-] Multiplier applied after sustained easy convergence.

substep_shrink_factor.description: [-] Multiplier applied after a rejected Richards trial.

substep_successes_before_grow.description: [-] Consecutive accepted trials required before timestep growth.

substep_hold_after_reject.description: [-] Accepted trials that retain the reduced timestep after a rejection.

output_dir.description: Run output directory. Relative paths resolve from the site folder; STEMMUS_OUTPUT overrides this.

wind_convert.description: Convert raw U to z_measure via log-profile.

scope.description: SCOPE radiative-transfer settings (was input_data.xlsx 'options'). File references resolve to data/model_library_nc/.

soil_heat_method.description: 0 = static force-restore; 1 = dynamic force-restore using current top-soil thermal inertia; 2 = 0.30*Rns SCOPE predictor followed by the Tss-driven soil solve.

model_library.description: Shared SCOPE reference-data filenames (resolve to data/model_library_nc/, same for all sites).

leaf_optics_file.description: PROSPECT leaf optical constants NetCDF file (nr, Kab, Kca, Kw, ...).

soil_spectrum_file.description: Soil reflectance library NetCDF file (used when scope.soilspectrum=0).

leaf_angles_file.description: OPTIONAL measured leaf inclination distribution NetCDF (13 angle bins). Empty => use [vegetation] LIDFa/LIDFb analytic Verhoef distribution.

directional_angles_file.description: BRDF observer-angle NetCDF under data/model_library_nc/ (var data: N x 2 [tto_deg, psi_deg]). Used when scope.calc_directional=true. Default: directional/brdf_angles2.nc.

leaf_optical.description: PROSPECT-PRO leaf biochemistry -> RTMo/fluspect (was input_data.xlsx 'inputdata'). Default values are SCOPE template, not yet site-calibrated.

fluor_qLs.description: [-] Fraction of functional PSII reaction centres.

soil_optical.description: Soil reflectance + evaporation resistances -> RTMo/ebal (was input_data.xlsx 'inputdata').

BSM_brightness.description: [-] BSM soil brightness (scope.soilspectrum=1; SCOPE2 input_borders range).

BSM_lat.description: [deg] BSM spectral-shape parameter (NOT the site latitude; SCOPE2 input_borders range).

BSM_lon.description: [deg] BSM spectral-shape parameter (NOT the site longitude; SCOPE2 input_borders range).

geometry.description: Observation geometry; solar zenith (tts) is auto-computed from site lat/lon/time.

PFT_type.description: PFT name; selects defaults from model_library PFT table (e.g. Apple, Spring Wheat, Temperate Corn, C3 grass, BDT temperate, NET Temperate). See getPFTParameterSet.m for the full list.

surface_type.description: Allen Table 4.1 surface type (only used when method = table).

crop_code.description: Leaf-width lookup for resistances_clm45: 1 = use leaf_width directly (static width); other codes = Tao-LAI inferred width. Loader maps to cfg.Veg.CropCode.

leaf_width.description: [m] Characteristic leaf width (leaf boundary-layer resistance). Loader maps to cfg.Veg.w_leaf_max.

vegetation_data_file.description: Optional site-relative CSV/XLS/XLSX vegetation observation table for LAI/hc/SAI data modes. Legacy InPlant layout: DOY, LAI, hc, Vcmax, Cab, SAI.

LIDFa.description: Verhoef leaf-inclination-distribution parameter a (|LIDFa|+|LIDFb|<=1). -1/0=erectophile, -0.35/-0.15=spherical, 1/0=planophile. Feeds RTMo/RTMt via equations.leafangles.

clumping_index_source.description: Foliage clumping-index source. pft_table uses the selected COMPASS PFT; manual uses clumping_index.

clumping_index.description: [-] Foliage clumping index Omega used only by canopy radiative transfer when clumping_index_source=manual. Omega=1 is random foliage; smaller values are more clumped.

canopy_layer_profiles.description: Unified canopy-layer structure/diagnostics switch; loader maps this to legacy options.calc_vert_profiles.

canopy_air_ta_feedback.description: Feed canopy-layer Ta back to leaf EB.

canopy_storage_per_LAI.description: [mm/LAI] Max canopy water storage per LAI.

hydraulic_scheme.description: Plant hydraulics: steady_spac | storage_from_psi | storage_dynamic. Legacy aliases: equilibrium, dynamic.

root_hydraulic_krmax.description: [m/s] CLM5 root tissue krmax; 0 disables the CLM5-krmax branch.

root_contact_psi_start.description: [MPa] Soil psi where contact resistance begins.

root_contact_psi_end.description: [MPa] Soil psi at full contact resistance.

retention_slope_root.description: [1/m] PV-curve slope, root (loader maps to dyn_a_retention_root).

retention_slope_stem.description: [1/m] PV-curve slope, stem (loader maps to dyn_a_retention_stem).

retention_slope_leaf.description: [1/m] PV-curve slope, leaf (loader maps to dyn_a_retention_leaf).

water_capacity_root.description: [m] Root water storage capacity (loader maps to dyn_W_capacity_root).

water_capacity_stem.description: [m] Stem water storage capacity, dominant capacitor (loader maps to dyn_W_capacity_stem).

water_capacity_leaf.description: [m] Leaf water storage capacity (loader maps to dyn_W_capacity_leaf).

path_root_to_stem.description: [m] Root->stem water path length, gravity correction (loader maps to dyn_dz_rs).

path_stem_to_leaf.description: [m] Stem->leaf water path length, gravity correction (loader maps to dyn_dz_sl).

stem_capacitance_lag.description: [s] Stem storage lag time constant (0 = instantaneous; loader maps to dyn_tau_stem_s).

tree_DBH.description: [cm] Diameter at breast height; only used to estimate gpmax when hydraulic_gpmax <= 0.

tree_CAH.description: [m2] Crown area per tree; only used to estimate gpmax when hydraulic_gpmax <= 0.

tree_Ksmax.description: [kg/m/s/MPa] Max stem hydraulic conductance; only used to estimate gpmax when hydraulic_gpmax <= 0.

FRGW1.description: Fraction of PHU at first LAI shape point.

FRGW2.description: Fraction of PHU at second LAI shape point.

DLAI.description: Fraction of PHU when LAI begins to decline.

vcmax_source.description: Vcmax25 base source; LUNA overrides daily when luna=true. Loader maps pft_table->0, manual->2 (vcmax_flag).

cab_from_luna.description: Drive leaf Cab from LUNA dynamic N.

leaf_resp_method.description: Leaf Rd25 base method. Loader maps vcmax_proportional->0, atkin2015->2.

heat_gs_enable.description: Optional additive heat-induced gs after Medlyn. Default false (production off).

heat_gs_T_on_C.description: [degC] Leaf temperature where heat gs starts.

heat_gs_T_full_C.description: [degC] Leaf temperature where heat gs is full.

heat_gs_max.description: [mol/m2/s] Max additive heat gs when all gates open.

heat_gs_wt_on.description: [-] Hydraulic sfactor for full water gate.

heat_gs_D_lo_kPa.description: [kPa] VPD where heat gate starts closing.

heat_gs_D_hi_kPa.description: [kPa] VPD at/above which heat gate is closed.

heat_gs_A_lo.description: [umol/m2/s] An low end of photosynthesis gate.

heat_gs_A_hi.description: [umol/m2/s] An high end of photosynthesis gate.

snow.description: ClimaLand v1.0 bulk snow and its total-precipitation phase adapter.

precipitation_phase_model.description: Jennings et al. temperature-relative-humidity rain/snow partition used by ClimaLand neural-snow forcing tools.

wet_snow_hydraulic_conductivity_m_s.description: [m s-1] Drainage conductivity for excess snow liquid.

regularization_swe_m.description: [m] SWE regularization used by ClimaLand bulk temperature and phase change.

minimum_exchange_depth_m.description: [m] Minimum snow depth in the snow-soil conductive exchange denominator.

organic.description: Native AOM-DOM-MEMC/MEND soil organic C/N fixed structure. Calibratable parameters live in soil.csv.

sorption_model.description: DOC/DON closure: soil.csv Kd equilibrium or source-hour MEND dynamic sorption.

organic_n.description: Initialization and receiver C:N values; nitrogen remains an independent prognostic ledger after initialization.

boundary.description: All boundary settings are kept in one [boundary] table. Each water kind selects constant or variable head/flux behavior; variable interpolation is automatic.

water_boundary_file.description: Site-relative or absolute prescribed water-boundary CSV path; defaults to water_boundary.csv.

surface_water_capacity_cm.description: [cm] Maximum retained liquid depression storage for an atmospheric top boundary; zero gives immediate runoff at h_surface=0.

heat_top_value.description: [J cm-2 s-1] Used only for a specified top total-energy flux.

heat_bottom_value.description: [degC] Fixed temperature or [J cm-2 s-1] specified total-energy flux, selected by heat_bottom_kind; inactive for free_drainage_internal_energy.

dry_air_top_value.description: [Pa] Fixed pressure or [g cm-2 s-1] specified mass flux, selected by dry_air_top_kind.

dry_air_bottom_value.description: [g cm-2 s-1] Used only for a specified bottom dry-air mass flux.

fertilization.description: Fertilizer events; arrays align by index.

NH4_ratio.description: Fraction of event N as NH4.

NO3_ratio.description: Fraction of event N as NO3.

urea_ratio.description: Fraction of event N as urea.

pool_entry.description: Target state pool per event (optional; defaults from events_type). nh4_granule=solid NH4 slow-release, nh4_liquid=dissolved NH4, no3_liquid=nitrate, urea=urea.

organic_carbon_kg_ha.description: [kg C/ha] Total organic carbon entering modeled organic pools per event.

organic_cn_ratio.description: [(kg C)/(kg organic N)] Total organic input C:N; organic N is derived as C divided by C:N.

straw_return.description: Returned-straw management events; arrays align by index and are active whenever soil_carbon_model=true.

ownership.description: Explicit source ownership. crop_residue is rejected when live PlantCN litter already owns crop residues.

events_carbon_kg_ha.description: [kg C ha-1] Carbon returned per event.

events_cn_ratio.description: [g C g-1 N] Event organic C:N.

advanced.description: Reserved / cascade-only switches. validate() warns but physics ignores. Leave at defaults.

lh_TE.description: [ARCH-RESERVED] Temperature effect on matric head (not consumed).
